execution: Conda dyg-cold; CPU toy tests only; no real data/archive, checkpoint, model training, optimizer, GPU, or replay loaded/launched.

drivers.checks: Correct actual task schema (payload task dimensions), strict canonical P2/P3/P3A passed/pass with P4 running and bound evidence; engine.validate_freeze plus exact test+oracle byte authorization; per-origin guard and source/normalization/freeze/collection fences before/after replay; synthetic perturbations use frozen main-training normalization; oracle is first decoded after full inference and is not passed to model/policy; complete ordered test origins and full-origin outputs.
drivers.finding: No live 72-hour aggregate budget check after final output report serialization. replay calls budget_guard before metrics/artifact writing, then serializes predictions/alignment/metrics/final JSON and performs integrity checks; main immediately sets receipt completed. Add a final budget_guard after write_final_artifact_report/final serialization before return/completion.

drivers.checks: Task dimensions are read from payload task (not fabricated config fields); test phase gate and hash-bound evidence; test freeze binds checkpoint/parameters/policy plus exact stress collection bytes/fingerprint and source/dependency/kernel; each origin checks budget; final report is fenced by guards before and after serialization and full source/data/freeze checks; targets are outside kernel inputs; complete ordered origins and 5-arm NPZs.
drivers.finding: Stress task/node order and checkpoint train stats are checked, but frozen normalization is only applied/verified when every dataset is synthetic. For real non-synthetic stress collections the driver does not assert each PreparedData mean/std/scale equals checkpoint statistics before replay. Either assert exact train-normalizer equality or explicitly reject those collections; byte allowlisting alone does not bind normalization semantics.

drivers.checks: Strict canonical gate validates passed/pass P2/P3/P3A, running P4, unique stage IDs and hash-bound inputs/evidence; validates accepted epsilon and test support from metadata; guards origins/batches to validation only; checks full ordered validation predictions/targets/masks, input hashes, checkpoint params, and exposes combined-NPZ materialization explicitly as test_accessed while stating no test origin/window/target feedback.
drivers.finding: The final gate fence references local variable canonical_gate_bytes at line 632, but the function only binds canonical_state (line 521) and never assigns canonical_gate_bytes anywhere. Successful calibration therefore reaches a NameError after writing the validation artifacts and before status=completed. Capture canonical pipeline bytes alongside the initial state and pass them to _verify_final_canonical_gate. Existing CPU tests do not execute guarded_calibration through this finalization path.

limitations: All three writer-owned CPU suites passed, but none establishes actual checkpoint replay or phase completion.

For combined chronological NPZ calibration, datasets_at may materialize whole-array test values/masks; guards prevent test-origin/window/target use, and result metadata discloses materialization rather than claiming no test bytes were touched.
This review is an independent engineering check only; it cannot pass a pipeline stage or establish a scientific outcome.
